question: This is the Port Calder subway map. Running times between adjacent stations differ by line (see the table on the map), and every change of trains takes 5 minutes. Read the service notice and take it into account. What is the shortest possible travel time, in minutes, from Fairmount Sq to Orchard St? Count riding time and change time only (no waiting at Fairmount Sq). Answer with a single integer.
